jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer, ERP Integrations
jobs.content: <p>Lathewise (YC W26) is a seed-stage startup building AI agents that read engineering drawings and turn RFQs into quotes for aerospace machine shops.</p><h3>What you’ll do</h3><p>Connect our product to customers’ ERPs (SAP, Epicor, JobBOSS) and EDI feeds, sit with estimators on the shop floor, and turn what you learn into product. Python, Postgres and React.</p><p>In person 5 days a week in SoHo. Must be a U.S. person (ITAR).</p><p>$150K – $185K + 0.3%–0.6% equity.</p>

jobs.title: Founding Business Systems & Security Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Own our internal systems end to end: SSO and device management, SOC 2 Type I with Vanta, and ITAR controls for customer CAD data. You’ll be the first person on the team who owns business systems.</p>
